answer: Sybil farms get better through feedback: each clone tries a trick and the operator watches which ones get paid. Close that inlet. Score every identity in a sealed shadow ledger and settle payouts in one glacier-slow monthly release, with no per-action signal and no visible flags. Example: an operator launches 40 clones, each testing a different evasion tweak. All 40 show the same flat pending figure for weeks, so the farm learns nothing while its costs pile up like shale. At release, hidden flags zero the clones; honest agents never needed the feedback.
